name: coresmith-dev

ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/nix:1.extraNixConfig:
experimental-features = nix-command flakes
extra-substituters = https://openlane.cachix.org
extra-trusted-public-keys = openlane.cachix.org-1:qqdwh+QMNGmZAuyeQJTH9ErW57OWSvdtuwfBKdS254E=

onCreateCommand:
set -euxo pipefail; npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code 2>&1 | tail -3; nix profile install --accept-flake-config github:efabless/openlane2 2>&1 | tail -10; nix profile install --accept-flake-config github:efabless/openlane2#openroad github:efabless/openlane2#opensta 2>&1 | tail -10; nix profile install --accept-flake-config nixpkgs#yosys nixpkgs#verilator nixpkgs#magic-vlsi nixpkgs#klayout nixpkgs#iverilog 2>&1 | tail -10; apt-get update -qq; apt-get install -y libpython3.11 libpython3.11-dev; test -f /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libpython3.11.so.1.0; pip install --upgrade pip; if [ -f /workspaces/coresmith/requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r /workspaces/coresmith/requirements.txt; fi; pip install cocotb cocotb-bus; if [ -d /workspaces/coresmith/orchestrator ]; then pip install -e /workspaces/coresmith/orchestrator; fi; mkdir -p /root/.claude && printf '%s' "$CLAUDE_CREDENTIALS_JSON" > /root/.claude/.credentials.json && chmod 600 /root/.claude/.credentials.json; cat > /etc/profile.d/codespaces-setup.sh <<'EOSH'
# Auto-source codespaces secrets for SSH (non-login) shells.
[ -r /workspaces/.codespaces/shared/.env-secrets ] && set -a && . /workspaces/.codespaces/shared/.env-secrets && set +a
# Put the coresmith repo on PYTHONPATH so `import orchestrator` works
# (the editable install of coresmith-asic-orchestrator exposes
# architecture / langchain / langgraph as TOP-level packages, not
# under `orchestrator.*`), AND chain in the codespaces python's
# site-packages so the apt-libpython-embedded interpreter inside the
# cocotb sim finds cocotb / pygpi.
export PYTHONPATH=/workspaces/coresmith:/usr/local/python/3.11.15/lib/python3.11/site-packages${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}
# cocotb dlopens libpython3.11.so to embed Python in the sim binary.
# Codespaces python is static (no .so); apt libpython3.11 from the
# Ubuntu 22.04 base is ABI-compatible with system glibc/libm (whereas
# the nix-store libpython requires GLIBC_2.38 that this base doesn't
# have, so dlopen fails).
export LIBPYTHON_LOC=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libpython3.11.so.1.0
EOSH
chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/codespaces-setup.sh
postAttachCommand: bash -lc 'echo coresmith dev container ready. claude --version && openlane --version && yosys --version | head -1'
